purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined municipal fire station with legible apparatus, crew, command, and service functions.
architectural_rules: Apparatus bays must dominate the street-facing operational identity and connect directly to a usable apron.
Crew quarters must have a short, unobstructed response route to turnout gear and apparatus bays.
Public access must terminate at a watch desk or office rather than opening directly into crew sleeping space.
Workshop, hose, utility, and equipment functions must connect plausibly to apparatus operations and rear service access.
If the station is multilevel, stairs and any pole/drop representation must remain structurally supported and circulation must not depend solely on a damaged shortcut.

damage_doctrine.intent: Municipal station abandoned after disaster, with operational identity preserved despite localized collapse and exposure.
